SFA_check_region_1 = {
	# 1 Westkongo, alias WKG
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = SFA_consolidated_1 } }
		clear_array = global.SFA_cur
		set_temp_variable = { sfa_cur_region = 1 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = global.SFA_region_1
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cur = v }
		}
		SFA_check_current_region = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { sfa_result > 0 } }
			set_global_flag = SFA_consolidated_1
			set_variable = { global.SFA_consolidated^1 = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.SFA_region_patron_1 = sfa_result }
			event_target:SFA_survivor = {
				set_country_flag = SFA_regional_state
				SFA_add_export_idea = yes
				save_global_event_target_as = SFA_region_nation_1
				SFA_alert_patron = yes
				save_event_target_as = SFA_d_actor
				save_event_target_as = SFA_d_target
			}
			if = {
				# a survivor from another region that merely holds the most states here keeps its name
				limit = {
					event_target:SFA_survivor = { capital_scope = { check_variable = { SFA_region = 1 } } }
				}
				event_target:SFA_survivor = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								OR = {
									has_country_flag = SFA_sovereign_ally
									tag = SWA
									tag = MEZ
									tag = MZB
								}
							}
						}
						set_cosmetic_tag = SFA_WESTKONGO
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_d_region = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_d_type = 2 }
			SFA_push_dispatch = yes
			SFA_log_consolidation = yes
		}
	}
}

		SFA_check_current_region = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { sfa_result > 0 } }
			set_global_flag = SFA_consolidated_7
			set_variable = { global.SFA_consolidated^7 = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.SFA_region_patron_7 = sfa_result }
			event_target:SFA_survivor = {
				set_country_flag = SFA_regional_state
				SFA_add_export_idea = yes
				save_global_event_target_as = SFA_region_nation_7
				SFA_alert_patron = yes
				save_event_target_as = SFA_d_actor
				save_event_target_as = SFA_d_target
			}
			if = {
				# a survivor from another region that merely holds the most states here keeps its name
				limit = {
					event_target:SFA_survivor = { capital_scope = { check_variable = { SFA_region = 7 } } }
				}
				event_target:SFA_survivor = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = SFA_patron_GER }
						set_cosmetic_tag = SFA_RHODESIA
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { tag = BTS }
						set_cosmetic_tag = SFA_TSWANA
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								OR = {
									has_country_flag = SFA_sovereign_ally
									tag = SWA
									tag = MEZ
									tag = MZB
								}
							}
						}
						set_cosmetic_tag = SFA_ZAMBEZIA
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_d_region = 7 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_d_type = 2 }
			SFA_push_dispatch = yes
			SFA_log_consolidation = yes
		}
	}
}

SFA_transfer_region_nations = {
	# plan 4.4, from SFA_annex_peace_loser (ROOT annexed, event target SFA_peace_winner won, by capitulation or
	# a peace that leaves it one state): the loser's regions pass to the winner, which becomes their regional
	# state, and each region changes to the winner's patron
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = SFA_region_nation_1
			event_target:SFA_region_nation_1 = { tag = ROOT }
		}
		event_target:SFA_peace_winner = {
			save_global_event_target_as = SFA_region_nation_1
			set_country_flag = SFA_regional_state
			SFA_add_export_idea = yes
			SFA_alert_patron = yes
			SFA_get_patron_code = yes
		}
		set_variable = { global.SFA_region_patron_1 = sfa_code }

SFA_update_region_cells = {
	# plan 7.1: each region's holder bar, one cell per state sorted by allegiance, and its status for the
	# regions panel in global.SFA_region_status^<n>: 1 open, 2 contested (a patron's side holds land in it),
	# 3 consolidated, 4 stable (South Africa's) (generated)
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.SFA_region_status^num < 14 } }
		resize_array = { array = global.SFA_region_status size = 14 value = 0 }
	}
	# 1 Westkongo
	clear_array = global.SFA_cells_1
	set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_1
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 2 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_1 = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_1
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_1 = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_1
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 4 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_1 = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_1
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 5 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_1 = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_1
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 6 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_1 = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_1
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 7 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_1 = 7 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_1
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_1 = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.SFA_consolidated^1 = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.SFA_region_status^1 = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.SFA_region_status^1 = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.SFA_region_status^1 = 1 }
	}
	# 2 Kongo
	clear_array = global.SFA_cells_2
	set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_2
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 2 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_2 = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_2
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_2 = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_2
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 4 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_2 = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_2
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 5 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_2 = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_2
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 6 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_2 = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_2
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 7 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_2 = 7 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_2
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_2 = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.SFA_consolidated^2 = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.SFA_region_status^2 = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.SFA_region_status^2 = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.SFA_region_status^2 = 1 }
	}
	# 3 Ubangi-Schari
	clear_array = global.SFA_cells_3
	set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_3
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 2 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_3 = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_3
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_3 = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_3
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 4 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_3 = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_3
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 5 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_3 = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_3
		if = {

			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_13 = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_13
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_13 = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_13
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 4 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_13 = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.SFA_region_13
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { SFA_frame = 5 } }
			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_13 = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { sfa_aligned = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {

			add_to_array = { global.SFA_cells_13 = 6 }

		}
	}

}

SFA_regions_drop_patron = {

SFA_count_patron_regions = {
	# regions each patron has consolidated: the race strip's numbers (plan 7.1)
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = SFA_patron }
		set_variable = { SFA_regions = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.SFA_region_patron_1 = 1 } country_exists = USA }
		USA = { add_to_variable = { SFA_regions = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.SFA_region_patron_1 = 2 } country_exists = GER }
		GER = { add_to_variable = { SFA_regions = 1 } }
